title: The breathing hole on the object
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of The breathing hole on the object, about 2012 at Baltic Sea anomaly, between Sweden and Finland, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a treasure hunter, helped find a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland. He passes on what a diver, Stefan Hogeborn, told him about a dive there in 2012: that the surface was dusty and that a milky substance was coming out of a hole in the object, which they called a breathing hole. If true, it would suggest the object is not just rock.
